guide: This shows how to get an AI model to put a price on a footballer from his numbers, then check that price against what the market says. You need a free ChatGPT or Claude account, a spreadsheet such as Google Sheets, and a public stats source.
1. Pick one position and one league, so every player you compare plays a similar role.
1. Copy 20 to 30 players' public stats (minutes, goals, assists, age, contract length) from a public stats site into a Google Sheets tab.
1. Add a column with each player's published market value from a public transfer-value site, and keep it hidden from the AI for now.
1. Paste the stats into ChatGPT or Claude and ask it to explain which numbers should matter most for that position, and why.
1. Ask it to give each player a price in pounds, with a one-line reason, using only the stats you gave it.
1. Put its prices beside the published values in the sheet and sort by the gap.
1. Read the biggest gaps one by one and ask the AI what the stats cannot show, such as injuries, wages or a club's need to sell.
1. Keep the sheet and run it again after the next batch of matches.
Watch out: an AI price is an estimate from the numbers you gave it, not a real valuation, so never present it as one, and check every stat against its source before you trust the result.

```
You are helping me price footballers from public stats, as a learning exercise rather than a real valuation.
I have a Google Sheet with <number> players who all play as <position> in <league>. The columns are <list your columns, e.g. name, age, minutes, goals, assists, contract end>. I will paste the rows below.
Do this in order:
1. Tell me which of my columns matter most for <position>, and why, in plain English.
2. Give each player an estimated transfer price in pounds, with a one-sentence reason that uses only my columns. Do not invent any stat that I have not given you.
3. Return a table with the columns: name, estimated price, reason.
4. Then list three things my stats cannot capture that could make your prices wrong.
If my data looks incomplete or inconsistent, say so before you price anything. Keep the language simple and show how confident you are for each player (low, medium or high).
Here are my rows:
<paste rows>
```
